name: dues-management
description: Dues Management System - School of Sciences, UENR Sunyani

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix server run db:setup && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.fmt: npm --prefix server run fmt && npm --prefix client run fmt
scripts.fmt:check: npm --prefix server run fmt:check && npm --prefix client run fmt:check
